g.text: (a) share of in-text citation markers that resolve to a real source; denominators are stated per bar.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: (a) the 85.07% streaming value is diagnostic only; the frozen batch contributes 1,649 / 1,649 resolved markers, 0 outside.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: (b1) D2 is scored only where retrieval happens (Track A); B–E produce no citations. (b2) n = 84 per track (Track D n = 80).

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: (b2) blue = kimi-k2.6, gold = glm-5.3; citation support ≠ resolvability ≠ factuality.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: (c) n = 96 judge × question verdicts per arm (48 q × 2 judges); rate = per-question mean of hallucination booleans.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: (c) A is the no-web baseline, not evidence for the two-section isolation; B − C' gap 5.2 pp < MDD 12.4 pp → not distinguishable.
